analyses.content: 业务员询问这是否是他第一次来墨尔本，他明确回答了“No”，并补充说之前已经来过两次。
你可能会听到“twice”或问题里的“1st”，但题目问的是“First time visited Melbourne（是否是第一次访问）”，直接填入他回答的首词“no”即可。
Was this your 1st visit to Melbourne?" "No, I have actually been there twice before.
录音中他强调自己最喜欢的部分（most impressed by）是这里令人惊叹的天气（amazing weather）。
录音中提到了野生动物（wildlife）和景点（sights），但紧接着用“but”进行了转折，排除了这两个干扰项。

Now, what would you say was your favorite part about Melbourne?" "Well, I did like seeing the exotic wildlife, and there are great sights to see, but I have to say I was most impressed by the amazing weather." "Yeah, the weather there is amazing.
他明确表示市政厅（Town Hall）绝对是他最喜欢的（Definitely my favorite）景点。
你可能会因为先听到剧院（theater）或水族馆（aquarium）而填错，但他评价剧院不如市政厅酷，对水族馆印象也不深，要注意听“favorite”对应的最终选择。

And of those, which was your favorite?" "1st I saw the theater, which was beautifully designed. It was not nearly as cool as the Town Hall though. The building is a huge part of Melbourne’s history. Definitely my favorite. I saw the aquarium too, but wasn’t too impressed." "I see. Yes, people often have great reviews of Town Hall.
业务员问他最喜欢食物的哪一点，他直接回答说喜欢这里食物的多样性（variety）。
题目中已经给出了“of food”，录音里列举的海鲜（seafood）和汉堡（burgers）只是为了举例说明食物种类多，不要把具体的食物名称填进去。

Could you tell me a little bit about what you most enjoyed about the food?" "Being such an international city, I loved the variety. I could find any type of food I wanted, whether I wanted seafood, burgers, or anything else.
他明确表示为了节省时间，最终决定乘坐飞机（by plane）前往目的地。
录音里提到了开车（drive）和坐火车（train），但开车被他直接否定，坐火车也因为时间关系被放弃，你要抓取的是“decided to”后面的最终决定。
Did you drive to Melbourne?" "No, I flew. I thought about going by train, but in the interest of time, I decided to go by plane.
他提到自己上周刚满41岁，完美对应提问选项中的“大于40岁（older than 40）”。
你可能会听到“under 20”，但那是他假想“如果自己还不到20岁就好了”，要注意“Actually”之后交代的真实年龄。

And would you mind telling me whether you are under 20, between the ages of 20 and 40, or older than 40?" "Uh, it would be nice if I was still under 20. My vacation probably would have been quite different. Actually, though, I just turned 41 last week.
他明确回答自己目前处于中等收入水平（mid-range income level）。
录音中提到了低收入（low-income），但那是他过去的生活状况，注意区分时态，不要把以前的情况当成现在的答案。

So did you treat yourself and fly 1st class?" "[laughs] No way. I would love to have a budget that high. I’m more in the mid-range income level. I wasn’t always though. I spent much of my life in a low-income household." "I see. That answers my next question then of income level.
他说以前经常去那里出差，但决定这次去是为了旅游（tourism）。
卷面上已经给出了出差（on business），所以你要抓取的是“decided”引出的这次旅行的新目的。
And what was the purpose of this visit?" "I had to go there on business a lot before and decided I would go there for tourism this time.
他正面回答自己的主要职业是一名计算机程序员（computer programmer）。
题目中已经给出了“writer for a travel magazine（为旅游杂志撰稿）”，你需要填的是他一开口提到的“主要职业（mainly a...）”，不要漏掉前面的核心身份。
And what is your occupation?" "I am mainly a computer programmer. I also write for a travel magazine on the side, which is why I visited Melbourne before, but it’s not my main source of income.
他一上来就直接评价自己的酒店住宿非常物超所值（good value）。
你可能会听到“expensive”或“cheap”，但那是用来对比城市里其他消费贵或者偏远地区便宜的汽车旅馆，并不是用来形容他自己住的酒店。

Would you care to comment on your accommodation?" "My hotel was a good value. Staying in the city can get really expensive, so it was nice to find such a good price for the location and quality. I’m glad I didn’t end up in some cheap motel in the middle of nowhere.
